description: Comptage routier dans le cadre du test de piétonnisation du Boulevard de la République is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Agen. These data are derived from the experimentation phase of the pedestrianisation of Boulevard de la République in its section between “the 4 boulevards” and the Place Castex carried out between 21 September and 18 October 2015. Coverage: Ville d'Agen. The portal shows the English title as "Road counting as part of the pedestrianisation test of Boulevard de la République" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Agen. Its keywords include transports-deplacements. The listing shows 5 download or service links in OCTET-STREAM, ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2015-10-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
